metadata.question: Did the glacial ice and snow cover on Mount Stanley in the Rwenzori Mountains decrease between 2020 and 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Mount Stanley is in the Rwenzori Mountains (Uganda/DRC border, ~0.38°N, 29.87°E) - Compare glacial ice/snow cover between 2020 and 2024 - Use Sentinel-2 for high resolution (10m) or Landsat if needed - Need to use snow/ice indices like NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) or NDWI - Date ranges: 2020 (full year or dry season) vs 2024 (full year or dry season) 2. Masking strategy: - Must mask clouds heavily as we're looking for snow/ice - Use cloud probability or QA bands - NDSI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) for snow detection - Threshold NDSI > 0.4 typically indicates snow/ice 3. Logic for valid results: - Valid Zero (B): If 2024 has equal or more snow than 2020 → Answer B (No decrease) - Valid Positive (A): If 2024 has less snow than 2020 → Answer A (Yes, decreased) - C1: No images in either period - C2: Images exist but all masked out - C3: Calculation returns null/invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions - Mount Stanley, Rwenzori Mountains const mountStanley = ee.Geometry.Point([29.8717, 0.3854]).buffer(3000); // 3km buffer around peak const date2020Start = '2020-01-01'; const date2020End = '2020-12-31'; const date2024Start = '2024-01-01'; const date2024End = '2024-12-31'; // 2. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to add NDSI function addNDSI(image) { const ndsi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('NDSI'); return image.addBands(ndsi); } // 3. Data Acquisition for 2020 let col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(mountStanley) .filterDate(date2020Start, date2020End) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addNDSI); const size2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2020 Images found: ${size2020}`); if (size2020 === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 data for 2020, trying Landsat 8...'); col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(mountStanley) .filterDate(date2020Start, date2020End) .map(function(img) { const ndsi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']).rename('NDSI'); return img.addBands(ndsi); }); const size2020L8 = col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2020 Landsat 8 Images found: ${size2020L8}`); if (size2020L8 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // 4. Data Acquisition for 2024 let col2024 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(mountStanley) .filterDate(date2024Start, date2024End) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addNDSI); const size2024 = col2024.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2024 Images found: ${size2024}`); if (size2024 === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 data for 2024, trying Landsat 9...'); col2024 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(mountStanley) .filterDate(date2024Start, date2024End) .map(function(img) { const ndsi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']).rename('NDSI'); return img.addBands(ndsi); }); const size2024L9 = col2024.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2024 Landsat 9 Images found: ${size2024L9}`); if (size2024L9 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // 5. Calculate snow/ice cover (NDSI > 0.4) const snowMask2020 = col2020.select('NDSI').median().gt(0.4); const snowMask2024 = col2024.select('NDSI').median().gt(0.4); // 6. Calculate pixel counts const stats2020 = snowMask2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: mountStanley, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2024 = snowMask2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: mountStanley, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const snowPixels2020 = stats2020.get('NDSI').getInfo(); const snowPixels2024 = stats2024.get('NDSI').getInfo(); console.log(`Snow/ice pixels 2020: ${snowPixels2020}`); console.log(`Snow/ice pixels 2024: ${snowPixels2024}`); // 7. Validation & Final Answer if (snowPixels2020 === null || snowPixels2024 === null) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (snowPixels2020 === 0 && snowPixels2024 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } const percentChange = ((snowPixels2020 - snowPixels2024) / snowPixels2020 * 100); console.log(`Change: ${percentChange.toFixed(2)}%`); if (snowPixels2024 < snowPixels2020) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
